summary: Checked file-handle seek wrapper. If a1 is a valid open file index (a1 below the uNumber count and the record's flag byte, at offset 4 of the per-file record, having bit 0 set), it enters the per-file critical section, performs a seek via FilePointerSeekWithErrorHandling, leaves the critical section and returns the seek result. Otherwise it writes error code 9 into the primary TLS slot, zeroes the secondary TLS slot and returns -1.

operations.description: Validity guard: a1 < uNumber (count of file records) AND the byte at dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 4 has bit 0 set (record open).
CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit(a1) enters the per-file critical section before seeking.
FilePointerSeekWithErrorHandling(a1, a2, a3, dwMoveMethod) performs the seek and returns the result stored in v4.
FileCriticalSectionLeave(a1) releases the per-file critical section.
Return the seek result v4 on the success path.
On the invalid-handle path, store 9 into the dword at TLSOffsetGetter() (TLS error code).
Store 0 into the dword at TLSOffsetGetter_afd8() (secondary TLS slot).
